Name: Erwin Smith - NPC - Attack on Titan
Author: LittlePippi
TagLine: This mod adds Erwin to Pelican Town. An NPC with custom dialogue, many events, story and character development. Datable and marriageable.
Description:
﻿After losing his right arm and nearly his life, Erwin Smith decided to settle in Pelican Town to run the Adventurer’s Guild. He might have lost his Commander role, but not the mindset. There’s always an enemy and it’s now Erwin’s mission to keep the town safe from evil.

Though composed and polite, Erwin carries the quiet weight of a man who sacrificed everything for a cause that no longer exists. He’s thoughtful, intelligent, and endlessly curious, some would say with a bad sense of humour. He’s a man burdened by past decisions and often slipping into his old Commander persona. As your bond with him deepens, you'll uncover the quieter layers beneath his stoic exterior.

FEATURES
11 events
3 quests + a storyline
Tons of original dialogue (500+ lines)
Dating and marriage
A new map, weapon, amulet and shirt
Seasonal Outfits for Erwin
Custom babies/toddlers
Lots of mail

CONTENT WARNING
﻿This mod contains mentions of war and heavy topics such as betrayal, and includes NSFW/spicy content in the marriage dialogue.
No prior knowledge of Attack on Titan is required. This mod is fully adapted to the Stardew Valley universe - no Titans, no supernatural elements beyond the established in-game magic and creatures. Erwin is leader of the Adventurer’s Guild and fights the monsters in the mines.
